about.body: Vera Coffee Solutions is built by operators, for operators. From our Bridgeport, CT facility we sell, install and service the world's best commercial espresso equipment — and at our Long Island City roastery we roast coffee for cafés, restaurants and corporate accounts who want a program built around their brand.
